title: Lunar Site Navigator package contract, version 0.4
description: One schema for the four JSON documents of the contract. The document type is selected by the 'kind' field. See docs/contract/SPEC.md for the meaning of every field.

utc.description: UTC instant, ISO 8601, millisecond resolution, always with the Z suffix.

array_ref.description: A raw little-endian binary array stored next to the manifest. C order (last index varies fastest).

quantity.description: A single number with its unit and its method card.

method_card.description: What a number means, how it was computed, from which data, and how far it has been checked.

time_grid.description: Uniform time axis. Sample i is at start_et_s + i * step_s, in TDB seconds past J2000.

provenance.description: Volatile record of how and when the package was produced. Not part of package_id or content_sha256.

azimuth_grid.description: Uniform azimuth axis covering the full circle. Sample j is at start_deg + j * step_deg; count * step_deg = 360.

window.description: An interval set: the times at which a stated condition holds.

scenario.description: The single input file of the tool (decision 5).

index.description: List of the packages under one package root, so that static readers need no directory listing.

obstacle.description: A run of neighbouring azimuths whose horizon is set by the same piece of terrain.

blocker.description: An obstacle that hides a body during time in which a smooth sphere would show it.

requirement.description: A stated mission requirement on the landing time, built from visibility windows.

opportunity.description: Landing times for which a stated requirement holds, for one observer height.

uncertainty_request.description: Stated assumptions for the uncertainty band and the landing-ellipse survey.
